opportunity: kuna applies NO demangled C++ signature: on stripped google/leveldb, functions whose first parameter is a named pointer are ghidra 188 / ida 150 / binja 60 / angr 0 / kuna 0. demangle_raw (the full c++filt form) had existed with no production caller since the demangler landed, its own header recording the signature application as a deferred follow-up.
test_name: kuna-console verify_cppsig (7 two-pass e2e assertions) + 19 hermetic parser/this-decision unit tests + whole-binary decompile-all sweeps
inspiration: Ghidra DemangledFunction.applyTo / GnuDemanglerAnalyzer "Apply Function Signatures"; the string-parsing shape is GnuDemanglerParser, which likewise consumes the c++filt text rather than an AST
root_cause: Not a defect but an unbuilt half: the demangler reduces a mangled symbol to its qualified NAME only, because kuna's `::`-scope splitter requires it. The signature -- the class type for `this` plus the declared parameter types -- was never applied, and on a STRIPPED C++ shared library the mangled `.dynsym` symbol is the only signature source that exists. The reason it was hard rather than merely undone is the implicit object parameter: Itanium mangles a static member function exactly like a non-static one and like a namespaced free function, and inventing a `this` that is not there shifts every following parameter (binja's bug, in the other direction).

benchmark.corpus: decbench leveldb O0 (stripped libleveldb.so.1.23 + leveldbutil), n=525 scored functions
benchmark.scorer: decbench origin/main @325046f (PR #60, the C++ type_match artifact fixes); cache_version 5, DECBENCH_NO_CACHE=1
benchmark.note: kuna moves from LAST (9) to SECOND (35 at the shipped default, tied with ida; 38 opt-in), 6 short of ghidra's 44. The 26 newly perfect functions at the default are exactly the destructors and trivial accessors decbench's own miner nominated.

this_decision_accuracy.corpus: 1329 mangled .dynsym FUNC symbols in leveldb with DWARF ground truth (915 really take `this`)

notes: Return types are deliberately NOT applied (Itanium encodes one only for a template function; upstream's resolveReturnType returns null and keeps the recovered type). __thiscall model selection is the named follow-up; 32-bit MSVC __thiscall is REFUSED rather than mis-placed because that ABI passes `this` in ECX. Complementary to cppproto (#264): the commit applies cppsig first so a DWARF prototype overwrites it wherever both reach a function.
